recentItems.title: First Class Fest Cypher (feat. Katozai, 10k Moss, Wxvy Jackson, Sayso, JAHSH)
recentItems.description:
Stream the First Class Fest Cypher for free on Audiomack: https://amack.it/fcf-cypher
Listen to the official First Class Fest playlist: https://amack.it/fcf-playlist


In the lead up to Toronto's First Class Festival, we had 5 of the best local artists and some producers link up at the studio to record a cypher and 4 other Audiomack exclusives, each with their own music video. 

Featuring:
Katozai
10k Moss
Wxvy Jackson
Sayso
JAHSH
